name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the previous dialogue and maintains the context of the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the ability of the response to encourage further conversation and interest from the other participant.

name: Informative Value
description: Evaluates whether the response provides interesting information or insights that contribute to the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Determines how logically structured and clear the response is within the flow of the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and uniqueness of the response compared to typical conversational replies.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the degree to which the response demonstrates understanding and connection to the other person's feelings or experiences.
